answer: The orchard report exposes the merge explicitly at each trellis. Each collapsed cluster gets one comet weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, a hostile operator who spins up 26 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 256 times the capital for one share. A farm of 504 identities would post 3248 proofs and burn roughly 89 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
